rationale: The replication confirms the paper's central qualitative claim: zero-field finite-momentum (FF) superconductivity emerges in a d-wave altermagnet when the superconducting gap nodes coincide with altermagnet nodes. The lower FF-window edge (t_am≈0.44) is exactly reproduced. However, due to coarse k-grid resolution (24×24 vs. paper's 1000×1000), the upper FF-window edge collapses prematurely (t_am≈0.48 vs. paper's 0.56), and the full B-t_am phase diagram with field-induced superconductivity was not attempted. Core mechanism verified but quantitative phase boundaries and broader phase diagram remain unconfirmed.
